subject: PO header, billing cadence and net term exception request
messages:
From: Luke Adams <luke.adams@everwellhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, procurement@everwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: PO header, billing frequency and net term exceptions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to reach out with a few billing constraints we need to lock down before we can issue a PO. High level: evergreen vendor setup is straightforward, but our finance team requires a few items on vendor invoices so our ERP (Coupa) will accept them reliably. Can you confirm if Redwood can support the following?

- PO header: must include PO number, Everwell GL cost center (CC-4062), and vendor tax ID in the invoice header.
- Line-level SKU mapping: we need SKU tags to map to our sub-ledgers (up to 5 line tags per invoice).
- Billing cadence: preferred monthly consolidated invoice with the ability to request a single consolidated quarterly statement for reconciling.
- Net terms: Everwell standard is Net 60, but we have flexibility to approve Net 45 for strategic vendors — we want to know if Redwood can accept Net 45 instead of your default Net 30.
- Pre-billing / advance authorizations: we sometimes need a short advance credit to cover ramp months (one-time prebill). Any constraints?

I've attached our Coupa PO template export (CSV) to show header expectations. If anything needs clarifying I can loop in our AP lead (procurement@everwellhealth.com).

Appreciate a quick confirm or suggested path to meet these requirements.

Best,
Luke Adams
Sourcing Manager, Everwell Health
Attachment: Everwell_PO_template_Coupa.csv

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Luke Adams <luke.adams@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: PO header, billing frequency and net term exceptions

Hi Luke — thanks for the clear list and the template. Short answers up front: yes on PO header fields, yes on line-level tags (we can emit custom invoice metadata fields), and we can support monthly consolidated invoices. Net terms and pre-billing need a quick internal review but we have a common compromise that often works for customers.

Proposed approach:
- PO header: we will ensure every invoice includes PO number, vendor tax ID and a custom field for your GL cost center (we'll map CC-4062 to the invoice header). Attachment: Redwood_PO_Header_Guidance.pdf shows the header layout and field names.
- SKU/line tags: our billing system supports up to 8 custom line tags; please confirm the exact tag keys you need.
- Billing cadence: we can issue monthly consolidated invoices and include a single quarterly reconciliation statement on request.
- Net terms / pre-bill: standard Redwood hosted terms are Net 30, but for enterprise deals we can accept Net 45 with the following: signed SOW/MSA amendment, finance approval and a one-time prebill for ramp months limited to 30% of forecasted monthly spend. If you'd like Net 60 that may require a purchase order guarantee or accelerated prepayment.

Next steps I propose:
1) If you confirm tag keys and the Coupa field names, we'll produce a test invoice sample showing mapping.
2) I'll loop in Ben (Finance) and Grace (Solutions) to finalize the Net 45 concession and draft a short billing SLA showing prebill limits.
3) Once approved, provide the PO with header fields populated and we'll align ERP remittance instructions.

Let me know a good time for a 30-min call this week if you prefer to walk through.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_PO_Header_Guidance.pdf

From: Luke Adams <luke.adams@everwellhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@everwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: PO header, billing frequency and net term exceptions

Vanessa — thanks for the quick response and the guidance doc. A few clarifications from our AP team after reviewing your proposal:

- Tag keys: they need the following line tags: svc_code, project_id, funding_pool, cust_account, department_tag.
- Monthly consolidated invoice is fine; we do also need the capability to request a single invoice per legal entity for quarters where we do centralized reconciliation.
- Net 45 is acceptable to our procurement lead, but to proceed we need a simple amendment to the MSA and a written billing SLA that calls out the prebill cap and dispute resolution timelines.
- Our Coupa team also prefers the vendor remittance address to be present on the invoice PDF and the invoice metadata (pdf metadata) to include the vendor_tax_id field.

I've attached our Coupa sample export as a CSV (same file as before) and the contact for our AP lead (procurement@everwellhealth.com). If Ben/Grace can draft the amendment + SLA, we'll aim to get a PO issued by June 2.

Appreciate the partnership — happy to take a short call if it helps.

Regards,
Luke
Attachment: Everwell_PO_template_Coupa.csv

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Luke Adams <luke.adams@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, procurement@everwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 May 2027 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: PO header, billing frequency and net term exceptions

Luke / Team — looping in final approvers from our side and proposing a concrete path forward: 

On Net terms and pre-bill:
- Ben from Finance has approved Net 45 for Everwell under a one-page Billing SLA (attached) that includes the pre-bill cap at 30% of estimated month-1 spend and a standard 45-day invoice payment window.
- If you require Net 60 we'd need a PO guarantee or an advance deposit equal to month-1 forecast; that is still an option if your AP prefers.

On invoice metadata and tags:
- Grace has validated the tag keys and Coupa mapping. We will produce a sample invoice PDF and a CSV export with the following metadata fields populated: po_number, vendor_tax_id, remittance_address, svc_code, project_id, funding_pool, cust_account, department_tag.

Operational next steps (proposed):
1) Redwood sends the one-page Billing SLA and a redlineable MSA amendment by EOD tomorrow. (Attachment: draft-billing-SLA-v1.pdf)
2) Everwell legal/procurement signs SLA and returns the PO referencing the agreed fields by 2027-06-02.
3) Finance kicks off a test invoice run to your Coupa sandbox to confirm automated ingestion (we'll coordinate with your AP contact).

I'll schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow at 11:00 AM ET to walk through deliverables — please let me know if that time doesn't work.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-billing-SLA-v1.pdf
